title: Compressible steady water waves
summary: In this paper, we consider the existence of small- and large-amplitude compressible water waves. These are solutions of the two-dimensional free boundary isentropic Euler equations subjected to a constant gravitational force and neglecting the effects of surface tension. We study periodic and solitary waves beneath vacuum as well as front-type solutions of the two-phase problem in a channel.
